title: Maximum Number of Moves to Kill All Pawns
sources: https://leetcode.com/problems/maximum-number-of-moves-to-kill-all-pawns/ (official page returns 403 to fetch; link from web search)
accessAttempt: Constraints and examples from the doocs mirror; the mirror is a paraphrase of the statement.
summary: Alice and Bob alternately capture pawns with a knight by the fewest moves; Alice maximizes the total number of moves, Bob minimizes it.
officialConstraints: no pawn starts on the knight square
visualizationNotes: Visualization caps positions at 6 pawns (2^6 masks); solver is the full bitmask DP and supports up to 15.
